candidates: Environment.Variables.OUTPUT_BUCKET in the UploaderFunction IaC template
Output S3 bucket resource referenced by UploaderFunction's OUTPUT_BUCKET
answer.explanation: Within 03:51:55Z–04:01:55Z, UploaderFunction failed on roughly every invocation (about 397 errors against about 398 START entries) with `NoSuchBucket` on `S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET, ...)` in /var/task/handler.py line 29. The error is NoSuchBucket, not AccessDenied, so the execution role's S3 permissions are not the cause, and the bucket name in OUTPUT_BUCKET points to a bucket that does not exist. The other three functions (CrudApi, Thumbnailer, Compression) logged only normal START/REPORT lines with no errors, so the fault is isolated to the uploader. The failures are also present earlier in the same window and in 30-minute buckets going back to at least 2026-10-18, so they did not start at the window boundary. I could not read the live function configuration or the IaC template with the available tools, so the exact env-var value and template line are inferred from the NoSuchBucket error rather than confirmed directly.
